pins.definition: A single level or story of a building.
A level or floor of a building, especially above the ground floor.
One level or storey of a building.

situation: A woman stands on the pavement looking up and pointing at the third-story window of an apartment building.
subject: the building level
brief: A tall mid-century apartment building stands cut in cross-section like a dollhouse, showing three distinct stacked living levels inside. A woman on the street below points upward at the third distinct horizontal tier, making the separate vertical layers clearly readable against the sky.
prompt: A tall mid-century apartment building stands cut in cross-section like a dollhouse, showing three distinct stacked living levels inside. A woman on the street below points upward at the third distinct horizontal tier, making the separate vertical layers clearly readable against the sky. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition.
